ID_CURRENCY_BASIC_MATERIALS_DETAILS: You can convert 40 Parts into 1 Skill Point for the character of your choice.
ID_CURRENCY_CRYSTALS_DETAILS: Crystals are used to purchase exclusive Shipments at the Starport. Shipments contain items such as Ability Modifiers, Emotes, Skins, and more!
ID_CURRENCY_EPIC_MATERIALS_DETAILS: Epic Parts are used to upgrade Ability Modifiers to level IV, the highest level of quality that can be crafted. They can also be acquired by Scraping the level IV Ability Modifiers you don’t want from the Character Screens.
